explication: This repository is a catalog of Java design-pattern examples and tutorials, not one application with a shared runtime. A reader finds an example by name, tag, or category, then studies its description and source. The graph groups representative examples by pattern family and includes the principal modules named in the source index. The README documents the browsing workflow; the available excerpts do not establish runtime links between these independent examples.
